preconditions.description: The number of vertices n, edges m, and queries q are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n and set(p) == set(range(1, n + 1))
preconditions.description: The initial values p_1 to p_n are a permutation of integers from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the valid range [1, n].
The number of edges provided matches m.

preconditions.expression: all((type == 1 and 1 <= v <= n) or (type == 2 and 1 <= i <= m) for type, val in queries)
preconditions.description: All queries are valid: type 1 has a vertex v in [1, n], type 2 has an edge index i in [1, m].
For type 2 queries, the specified edge is guaranteed to be currently present in the graph (not previously deleted).

postconditions.expression: len(output_lines) == sum(1 for t, _ in queries if t == 1)
postconditions.description: The number of output lines equals the number of type 1 queries.
Every output line is a non-negative integer.

For each type 1 query (1 v) processed in order, the output value corresponds to the maximum p_u among all vertices u reachable from v in the current graph state (after previous edge deletions and value resets), and immediately after outputting, that specific p_u is set to 0. If all reachable vertices have 0, the output is 0.
